grades.main_gap: Both directions open for general n: lower-bound insertion lemma (Theorem L, Case II) and upper-bound Lemma X1 are unproven; only small cases and reductions are complete.
grades.notes: Impressive partial work: correct conjectured value 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1), solid reformulations (alternating sum, matching duality), proved counting lemma and n<=2 cases, honest error tracking. But the two main theorems remain conjectural, so the result is not established.
